text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Strolling down the street one weekend, I
happen to spot Mejiro
McQueen, who
appears to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hm hm hmm! ♪ Don't stop! Go for victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I've been waiting all week for this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Better enter the karaoke place before
someone spots—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Th-that's right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is to say...
I was thinking of going to
practice my winning concert
songs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh? You wish to come along too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-well... Thank you. Let's be on our way,
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something feels rather off about
McQueen, but I follow her into the

karaoke place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whew. Let's pause it there for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What did you think about my singing? Did
you identify any points for
improvement?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's sung through quite the assortment of
songs, but she doesn't
seem to be enjoying
it much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just where did that good mood disappear
off to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What makes you say that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's not the case at all.
But how can I say
this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I should just be honest here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I didn't come to karaoke
today to practice Winning
Concert songs.
Actually...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wanted to sing some fight songs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, like the ones you hear fans sing at
sporting events to support
their team.
They're called fight songs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I happen to attend sporting events myself
sometimes... Once in a blue
moon, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I occasionally like to sing fight songs at
karaoke on my days off as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's the real reason why I came here
today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I shall do nothing of the sort!
I can't have
you seeing me act in such
a juvenile
fashion!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Uh... Y-you want to join in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now w-wait just a moment. I can go
without doing it today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But again, I don't want you to see how I
get...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, you've already entered a song?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: BRING 'EM HOME, YU-TA-KA!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: BRING 'EM HOME, YU-TA-KA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Any sense of shame that McQueen had
felt earlier is driven off by the
fiery chants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We shout just as if we were in the
stands at
a ballpark.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, that was a bit embarrassing.
Though, admittedly, it was
also quite fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I could, I'd go watch a game right this
instant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I had to say... I suppose I love the
atmosphere at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a member of the Mejiro family, I've
always felt it important to
maintain my
composure at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So when I went to my first sports
stadium, I
was quite taken aback. It
all just seemed
so lively.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The fact that there could be a place where
no one would judge you
for shouting and
flouncing about...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I found the experience to be very fresh
and inviting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, you could say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In any case, what do you say to getting
back to singing? I'm still
rather fired up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now that we've left, I can't help but
feel embarrassed after all. I
hope the other
patrons weren't able to hear me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well yes, that is true. It has been a long
while since I was able to let
loose to such
an extent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Though you must promise me this,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not a word about this will get out to the other students or staff. And if possible, I would like you to completely forget about it too...
